title: ESP32-simple_sleep_timer: light sleep with timer wake-up
description: An ESP32 program that enters light sleep, wakes up on a timer, and measures the time it slept. Written in C with ESP-IDF and FreeRTOS, in VS Code with PlatformIO, at the Universidade de Brasília with Prof. Jones Yudi Mori Alves da Silva.

contributors.name: Mori Alves da Silva, Jones Yudi
